Pair 100 · 0.5–1 cm below local surface · arrows 20× pair displacement
Both methods share arrow origins and scale. Grid is thinned equally; missing estimates are omitted. PIV is used only for comparison.
Cyan = local upper depth boundary; orange = 1 cm depth; dotted gray = retained-image boundary. Physical units and surface offset are assumed.
